ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of Phase-I (53.73 MW/222.969 MWh) of its Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project, with the Commercial Operation Date slated for October 2, 2026, marking progress in its energy infrastructure development. However, a significant operational concern exists as the corresponding renewable energy generation component, vital for the BESS's full functionality and revenue, remains under development. This disconnect implies the BESS may not operate optimally or generate immediate integrated system revenue until its power source is also complete.
